I would purposely complain about feeling ill in class, and would get sent to the nurse at least once a week. It was almost guaranteed that my Mom would be called to pick me up. I'd get home lay down, "feel better" and start playing N64.

I did the same thing but before I even went to school. My mom worked during the day so there was no one to see if I was really sick or not. It got to the point that they took me to the doctors and ended up diagnosing me with severe allergies. I think I missed a month of school in 5th grade. I would usually just sit at home and read instead. I only fessed up last year (20+ years latter).
